cell.asked_suffix: Follows a number in a narrow map cell ("12 asked"): leading space kept; max ~8 chars.
cell.held: {tier} is a tier code (T1/T2/T3). The stored tier is higher than the one in force because the risk settings hold it down.
common.arrow: Direction arrow between two states (before -> after). Use ← in right-to-left languages.
common.capped: Capped = this stakes level never earns autonomy: the agent always asks.
common.list_sep: Separator between profile names in a list.
common.one_in: A risk written as a frequency: "1 in 50". {k} is a number.
common.percent: {v} is an already formatted number; place the percent sign as your language does.
counters.actions.label: Short label under a large number in the header counters; plural follows that number. Max ~12 chars.
counters.faults.sub: {faults} faults out of {n} checks; plural follows {n}.
drawer.mobile_summary: Phone layout only. {sessions} is drawer.sessions_of or 'capped'. Trailing ' · ' is followed by more text.
drawer.revoke_note_other: {cmd} is a shell command, never translated.
event.tier: {from}/{to} are tier codes T1/T2/T3; {why} is one of the event.why.* texts.
event.trial.failed: {wait} is the number of actions to wait; plural follows it.
legend.alone: {share} is a frequency like "1 in 20" or legend.a_share.
map.empty.after: End of the sentence; see map.empty.before. Starts with a comma in English.
map.empty.before: Sentence split around a bold part: map.empty.before + map.empty.bold + map.empty.after.
map.empty.bold: Bold part of the sentence; see map.empty.before.
map.open_hint: Followed by the Enter key glyph; keep the trailing space.
missing.more_to_t2: Narrow map cell (~20 chars). T2 is a tier code.
missing.more_to_t3: Narrow map cell (~20 chars). T3 is a tier code.
missing.trial_left: {n} successes still needed out of {total} in the trial; plural follows {n}. Narrow map cell: keep short.
missing.trial_wait: {n} actions to wait before a new trial. Narrow map cell: keep short.
models.lede: Followed by models.lede_bold in bold, same paragraph.
page.live: Live indicator, followed by a time (HH:MM:SS). Keep the trailing ' · '.
page.raw_off: Toggle chip: action type names are redacted (default).
page.raw_on: Toggle chip: action type names shown raw.
page.retrying: Shown instead of page.live while the last refresh failed. Keep the trailing ' · '.
page.title: Product name: usually kept as is.
passport.value.hashed: {profile} is a hash of the profile name.
preset.balanced: Risk preset name, on a segmented control; the command keeps the English id.
preset.careful: Risk preset name, on a segmented control; the command keeps the English id.
preset.custom: Shown when the risks match no preset.
preset.fast: Risk preset name, on a segmented control; the command keeps the English id.
profile.read_only: Appended after a profile name; keep the leading ' · '.
profile.this_dashboard: Appended after a profile name; keep the leading ' · '.
settings.checks_in_row: Follows a bold number N; keep the leading space. Plural follows N.
settings.rung_cap: Ladder button meaning 'capped' (never acts alone). Max ~4 chars.
switch.count.carried: Count badge in the switch preview summary; plural follows {n}.
switch.delta: Signed difference in public score, after 'old -> new'. Keep the leading space.
switch.placeholder: {example} is a model id. 'model@provider' is a syntax hint: keep it literal.
tier.capped.chip: Tiny chip in place of a tier code. Max 4 chars.
tier.chip.title: Tooltip on a tier chip: {tier} code, {name} its tier.name.* meaning.
time.days: Short duration unit, as in a compact table cell ("3d").
timeline.count: Repetition count before a grouped timeline row ("3×").
totals.alone: Actions that ran without asking; {n} is a count.
totals.checked: Actions checked by the user; {n} is a count.
undo.window_ends: {duration} is a short duration (time.*), time left to undo.
verdict.unsigned.no_key: {cmd} is a shell command, never translated.
view.models: Tab label; the keyboard shortcut stays 'b'.
view.switch: Tab label; the keyboard shortcut stays 'w'.
